description: Breaks L6 (every card exists in the current catalog version): 19 legal ids plus core-999, which is not one of the 100 Core cards. Like the other single-deck illegal fixtures it also trips L5, since an id that is not in the catalog is not in the collection either. L6 is the message the spec asserts, and it is the one that carries the catalog version, so the spec reads that version from the server rather than spelling it.
